visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a light blue shirt dress, stands under a covered parking area in front of a large black Mercedes-Benz G-Class SUV. She smiles broadly at the camera while holding up the car keys, then points toward the vehicle with an enthusiastic gesture. (2) The scene cuts to a frontal view of the black SUV showing the large Mercedes-Benz emblem on the grille. The environment is bright and outdoor with sunlight reflecting off the car. The woman moves toward the vehicle, opens the heavy driver's door, and climbs inside. (3) Inside the cabin, the woman grips the steering wheel with both hands, showing visible physical effort as she maneuvers. The interior features black leather seats and a vintage-style dashboard with various dials. She drives through urban streets with green bushes and city buildings visible through the windows. (4) She accelerates on a wider road, displaying an excited and slightly strained facial expression. The camera captures her from a side angle as she continues to struggle with the steering wheel's weight. Later, she points with her finger to a visible damp sweat patch left on the leather seat. (5) A man wearing a black t-shirt and denim jeans enters the frame, leaning into the open driver's side door of the SUV. He looks down at the driver's seat with a mock-disgusted expression, while the woman sits nearby in the passenger seat laughing at the situation.
